research_result.description: Otter AI is an AI-powered meeting transcription and conversational intelligence platform that provides meeting transcripts, automated summaries, a REST API for enterprise workspaces, and an MCP server integration.
research_result.credential_requirements: API keys can be created under the Developer tab in workspace Integrations for Enterprise accounts (limit 2 keys per user). Access to the Public API requires an Enterprise workspace and may require contacting an Otter account manager to enable.
research_result.main_blocker: API access is restricted to Enterprise plan workspaces and requires account manager enablement.

evidence.claim: Otter.ai Public API requires Bearer token authentication with an API key.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: All API requests require authentication using Bearer token authentication. Follow the steps below to create your API key.

evidence.claim: Otter's MCP Server uses OAuth authentication.
Public API access is restricted to Enterprise customers and requires account manager contact to enable.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Yes, Otter offers a public API for Enterprise customers. To get started, contact your Otter account manager to enable access.

evidence.claim: Otter provides a REST API for Enterprise customers to retrieve transcripts and meeting summaries.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The platform provides a REST API for Enterprise customers to programmatically retrieve speech-to-text transcripts, speaker-identified conversation segments, and AI-generated meeting summaries.

evidence.claim: Otter offers an official MCP Server integration to connect meeting data to AI assistants.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Otter's MCP Server connects your meeting data directly to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, bringing your meeting intelligence into your everyday AI workflows .
